captions.detailed: This 3D model is a parametric honey dipper spoon. It features a cylindrical handle with a rounded, hemispherical top end. The bottom head of the dipper consists of a series of fanned, helical fins that spiral around the central axis, designed to catch and hold honey.
captions.instruction: Please design a parametric honey spoon dipper in OpenSCAD. The user should be able to adjust the spoon head height, twist angle, outer radius, and fan fin thickness, as well as the handle's height and radius.
captions.factory: The model is constructed by unioning two main modules: spoon() and holder(). The spoon() module uses a linear_extrude with a twist parameter to extrude a 2D profile consisting of multiple rotated rectangular polygons. The holder() module creates the handle using a cylinder of height handle_height_t and radius handle_radius, capped at the top with a sphere of the same radius using a translate transform.
